description: The expansion port's protocol v1 (protocol/expansion-port.md; draft RFC 'The expansion port', decisions EXP-7 to EXP-14, EXP-21, EXP-36): the CRC-8 (polynomial 0x07, initial 0, no reflection; a write's CRC covers the address byte as sent, address << 1), the frames a box reads and writes with their bytes after the address byte, good and refused with the reason, the reference modules they belong to, the lease's timelines, and node.modules' compact text. Made by tools/expansion_vectors.py; checked by simulator/tests/test_expansion.py (the Python reference model) and firmware/esp32/test/test_expansion.c (the box's port driver and a C model of a module, every case).

crc8.name: a LEASE 15 write to 0x5c, address byte first

timelines.name: lease_runs_out
timelines.description: The siren is on until off; the box refreshes the 1.5 s lease at 500 and 1000 ms and then stops (a crash): the module turns it off at 2500 ms and says lease_expired until the box writes again.

timelines.name: lost_write_repaired
timelines.description: A 5 s strobe is lost on the cable; the next STATUS (250 ms) shows it off and the box sends what is left, rounded up to 100 ms (4.8 s), which ends on the module's own timer at 5050 ms.

timelines.name: module_restart
timelines.description: A 10 s siren; the module restarts (a brown-out) at 800 ms and comes back off and fresh; the box sees fresh at 1000 ms, clears it and sends the 9 s left.

timelines.name: pulse_spanning_missed_polls
timelines.description: A 1 s pulse: the polls at 250 and 750 ms are missed and the refresh at 500 ms is lost; the module ends the pulse on its own timer at 1000 ms, with no lease_expired.

timelines.name: max_on_and_min_off
timelines.description: The smoke channel (max on 30 s, min off 30 s) is turned on until off and kept leased: the module turns it off at 30 s by itself, refuses it until 60 s, then takes a 1 s pulse.

timelines.name: relay_pattern_floor
timelines.description: A 50 ms pattern is refused on a relay channel and runs on the solid-state one (on first, then off, repeated, for its duration); a relay takes 100 ms.

timelines.name: relay_switches_at_most_every_100_ms
timelines.description: A relay channel turned off at 50 ms refuses to turn on again before 150 ms; off is never refused.

invalid.name: simple_output_not_servo
invalid.reason: the only simple output is servo
